incident-bot: ALERT: SLO breach detected for tenant "heliotrope" (single-tenant pool)
incident-bot: metrics at 2025-09-12T03:46:29Z — streaming p95=2.3s (baseline ~120ms), p99=6.2s (baseline ~300ms), error_rate=0.6%
praveen: ack, i'm on call. tagging @emma for potential handoff. what routes/models are affected?
olga: confirmed it's the heliotrope pool. both /stream and /generate routes show tail stalls. heatmap shows concentrated long tails in a ~60s window.
matt: seeing a huge spike in kvcache evictions and longprefix requests — many system messages >40k tokens.
praveen: can we pull kv/cache + queue metrics quickly?
raj: quick probes: evictions_total jumped to 12,348 at 03:45:40, kvcache_miss_rate ~0.84 (norm 0.12), streaming_stall_count ~1120 (many >5s), model_worker_queue_len avg 14 (typical 2), pod_cpu: model-instance-7 98%, model-instance-3 93%.
emma: any recent deploys to this pool? @deploy-bot show last deploy
deploy-bot: last deploy for pool "heliotrope-pool": 2025-09-12T02:50Z by @sylvia, model variant gptx-smallquant-v2.
matt: infra unchanged. logs show 120 concurrent streams started from a single app server within 30s — looks like client-side fanout or retry loop.
praveen: hypothesis: very long prefixes causing cold KV populates + sudden fanout -> kvcache thundering and worker queueing -> streaming stalls.
olga: can confirm kvcache_lock_wait_us spiked (median 45us -> 9.2ms). signs of lock contention on populate.
emma: mitigation options: 1) per-tenant concurrency cap, 2) overflow routing to smaller variant, 3) scale pool up, 4) evict problematic prefixes / set nocache. quick wins first.
matt: ops, can you apply a routing override to cap concurrency and route overflow to a lightweight variant?
olga: applying now: redwoodctl route override --tenant heliotrope --concurrency 20 --overflow gptx-micro-compat --expire 15m
olga: also bumped pool min replicas 4->8 for heliotrope. monitoring charts now.
praveen: good. enable verbose streaming debug on a couple worker nodes so we can correlate stalling stream ids.
matt: enabled on model-instance-3 and model-instance-7, collecting stream debug (filter stream.stall.*).
raj: within 90s after override p95 dropped to ~810ms and p99 to ~2.1s. streaming_stall_count rate down ~70%.
praveen: nice. can we identify hot prefixes triggering thundering? top prefix hashes: abcd1234 (6,420), ef90ff12 (5,987), hot_long_prefix_1 (4,200) — hot_long_prefix_1 looks like the long dump cluster.
emma: can we evict that prefix and mark it nocache temporarily to stop everyone repopulating?
olga: running: redwoodctl kvcache evict --tenant heliotrope --prefix hot_long_prefix_1; redwoodctl kvcache set-ttl --tenant heliotrope --prefix hot_long_prefix_1 --nocache --expire 10m
olga: eviction + nocache applied.
matt: logs show many worker threads blocked on kvpopulate for same prefix earlier; blocked threads fell ~80% after eviction.
praveen: i'm messaging heliotrope SRE now to ask them to pause their parallelization/prefill rollout and stop retries.
praveen: message sent to customer slack: "@heliotrope-sre we detected a burst of concurrent prefill/parallel summarization causing thundering; please pause the rollout and throttle retries immediately."
raj: customer responded: they did deploy a prefill feature to fan out context across workers to speed summarization. they didn't expect this to hotspot kvcache.
emma: current status: p95 ~700-900ms, p99 ~1.9-2.2s, error_rate trending down. mitigations live: routing override (concurrency cap 20, overflow -> gptx-micro-compat), pool scaled, prefix eviction nocache, debug logs enabled.
praveen: handoff notes for next oncall: keep overrides in place until customer confirms throttling; extend override if p99 > 2s after 15m; consider rollback to previous model variant gptx-stable-v1 if regressions persist; initiate longer-term fixes (prefill async warmups, increase kvcache parallel populate slots, auto-nocache rules). open product ticket for prefix hotness detection.
emma: i'll take over in 12m. leaving debug hooks for 20m then reducing logs. tagging @matt @olga for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: STATUS UPDATE: severity high -> mitigated, p99 reduced to ~2s, actions: routing override, pool scale, kvcache eviction, customer throttled. started 2025-09-12T03:46:29Z, mitigated 2025-09-12T03:59:12Z.
emma: closing note: follow-up items: add telemetry that correlates kvcache_lock_wait_us + stream_concurrency spikes to page earlier; add per-tenant burst policy and client guidance on fanout patterns. will file postmortem draft.
